how_the_commit_is_recorded: The git hash of a commit cannot be written inside the file that commit contains. The registry is therefore stamped by tools/stamp_preregistration.py, which records the hash of the commit that last changed this file and the SHA-256 of the file as committed. tools/check_preregistration.py fails when the file's hash no longer matches the stamp, which makes any post-hoc edit of a frozen rule a build failure.
rule: A backtest number may be published only when a registration record exists for the rule and the registration commit is an ancestor of the publishing commit. Enforced by tools/check_preregistration.py, which fails the build otherwise.

gates.name: walk-forward
gates.test: every input predates kick-off and every fit uses only earlier games
gates.source: data/s9cb/lines.json › lookahead_probe (predictions differ with future data)

gates.name: observed prices
gates.test: every scored bet carries a price from the source file; no -110 assumed

gates.name: sample size
gates.test: at least 200 scored bets in the backtest sample

gates.name: beats break-even
gates.test: hit rate above the break-even implied by the actual prices taken

gates.name: multiplicity
gates.test: Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p < 0.05 across the rules tested

gates.name: holdout
gates.test: positive in the untouched holdout window (2024 + 2025 backtest seasons)

gates.name: seasonal stability
gates.test: positive in at least 60% of individual seasons

gates.name: uncertainty
gates.test: 95% bootstrap interval on ROI excludes zero

gates.name: proper score
gates.test: benchmark-relative Brier skill on the same games, with a game-cluster bootstrap lower bound above 0

gates.name: pre-registration
gates.test: a registration record exists and its commit precedes the result
